thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/09/2018: TSM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, ASX

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/09/2018: TSM, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, ASX
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.15%
AAPL: -0.25%
IBM: -0.28%
CSCO: +0.59%
GOOG: -0.69%
Technology stocks were sinking in early Tuesday trading.
Sector news include:
(+) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ), which was up 0.34% after reporting sales of TWD94.92 billion ($3.07 billion) in September, an increase of 4.2% from the prior month and a gain of 7.2% compared with a year ago.
(=) ASE Technology ( ASX ) was unchanged after posting Q3 net revenue of $3.51 billion versus $2.08 billion for the previous quarter, which beat the $3.43 billion mean estimate of analyst polled by Capital IQ.
